jobs.title: Microsoft 365 & Security Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Sie entwickeln die Microsoft-Umgebung für Anwendungen und Daten weiter, betreiben Microsoft 365 und übernehmen Aufgaben im Sicherheitsbetrieb. Ihre Architektur soll mit dem Bedarf wachsen, wirtschaftlich bleiben und Daten schützen. Damit schaffen Sie die Grundlage für moderne Arbeitsplätze und vernetzte Geschäftsprozesse. Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen mit Produktionsstandorten in Deutschland und weiteren europäischen Ländern. Das Unternehmen baut seine IT-Organisation mit klaren Strukturen auf, entwickelt Betrieb und Sicherheit weiter und setzt auf Automatisierung, Daten und KI. Der Arbeitsort liegt in Niedersachsen, ca. 1 Stunde von Hannover entfernt. Ihre Aufgaben Microsoft 365 im Alltag – Sie betreiben und verbessern die M365-Umgebung. Mit Intune, Autopilot und Compliance-Richtlinien verwalten Sie Endgeräte und digitale Arbeitsplätze. Anwendungen und Daten – Sie entwickeln die Architektur für Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform und Fabric weiter. Für den Aufbau und das Zusammenspiel der Dienste setzen Sie Standards und berücksichtigen dabei Kosten, Sicherheit und Skalierbarkeit. Identitäten und Datenzugriff – Mit Entra ID und Purview setzen Sie Vorgaben für Identitäten, Zugriffe und Datenschutz um. Sie definieren, wer worauf zugreifen darf, wie Freigaben erfolgen und wie Lebenszyklen geregelt sind. Sicherheitsbetrieb – Für Systemhärtung, Sicherheitsmonitoring und die Bearbeitung von Sicherheitsvorfällen mit Defender und Sentinel sind Sie verantwortlich. Zusammen mit dem CISO und den IT-Teams unterstützen Sie die Umsetzung der Sicherheitskonzepte und der Vorgaben aus NIS2 und KRITIS. Technologieentscheidungen und Einführung – Sie beraten die Fachbereiche und Projektteams, bewerten Technologien und erstellen Unterlagen für die Entscheidungsfindung. Bei Einführungen und Rollouts begleiten Sie die Teams, etwa bei Copilot. Ihr Profil Berufspraxis und Ausbildung : Sie haben Microsoft 365 und Entra ID über mehrere Jahre betrieben und weiterent

jobs.title: Website Growth & CRO Manager
jobs.description: Berlin, Germany · Full-time Important: Business-fluent German (C1 or C2) is a must for this role, as optimizing website texts is a key part of the work. Applications with a lower level of German will not be considered. The Role We are looking for a highly analytical, action-oriented, and entrepreneurial Website Growth & CRO Manager to take ownership of our websites and help turn them into high-performing digital sales channels. In this role, you will drive improvements across our websites, landing pages, and conversion funnels, combining data-driven experimentation with strong UX/UI intuition, compelling copy, and a deep understanding of customer behavior. You will take ownership of conversion rates, identify opportunities for growth, and turn insights into tangible improvements. You will also contribute to the development of a new product configurator, helping shape intuitive digital experiences that make it easier for customers to discover, customize, and purchase our products. We’re looking for someone who thinks analytically, moves quickly, and enjoys taking ideas from insight to execution. Early-career candidates with exceptional analytical ability, initiative, and potential are also encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Website Product Ownership: Take ownership of existing websites, landing pages, and conversion funnels, continuously identifying opportunities to improve performance and the customer journey. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Design and implement A/B tests across entire pages and individual sections to improve conversion rates and generate measurable results. UX/UI & Web Experience: Create intuitive, visually compelling, and high-converting web experiences in collaboration with designers and AI tools. Copywriting & Messaging: Develop persuasive headlines, unique selling propositions (USPs), calls to action (CTAs), and website copy in German that clearly communicate the value proposition and encourage users to take action. Growth Experiment

jobs.description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time. Your Role As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. jobs.title: SAP ABAP Entwickler (m/w/d) bis zu 80%-Remote
jobs.description: Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Industrieunternehmen und Teil einer Unternehmensgruppe mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden. Moderne, hochautomatisierte Fertigungsprozesse, eine hohe Variantenvielfalt und eine leistungsfähige Logistik prägen das industrielle Umfeld. SAP bildet dabei die zentralen Geschäftsprozesse über nahezu alle Unternehmensbereiche hinweg ab. Zur Verstärkung des internen SAP-Teams suchen wir einen erfahrenen SAP ABAP Entwickler (m/w/d), der eigene Lösungen entwickelt, Verantwortung übernimmt und die anstehende Transformation auf SAP S/4HANA aktiv mitgestaltet. Aufgaben Sie entwickeln und optimieren SAP-Anwendungen mit ABAP und ABAP Objects. Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen analysieren Sie Anforderungen und übersetzen diese in technische Konzepte und praxistaugliche Lösungen. Sie begleiten den Entwicklungsprozess von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zu Tests und Dokumentation. Sie wirken an der Umstellung auf SAP S/4HANA und der Modernisierung der bestehenden Systemlandschaft mit. Sie unterstützen produktionsnahe SAP-Prozesse, insbesondere im Umfeld von SAP PP und der Maschinenanbindung. Sie entwickeln Schnittstellen zwischen SAP, Produktion, Lager sowie angrenzenden EWM- und MES-Systemen weiter. Je nach Aufgabenstellung setzen Sie moderne Technologien wie SAP Fiori, SAP UI5 und die SAP Business Technology Platform ein. Sie arbeiten eng mit den internen IT-Kollegen, den Fachbereichen und externen Entwicklungspartnern zusammen. Qualifikation Das bringen Sie mit: Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung. Sie haben mehrjährige praktische Berufserfahrung in der ABAP-Entwicklung sowie Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten. Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in ABAP und ABAP Objects. Sie bringen Erfahrung mit SAP PP sowie der Maschinenanbindung im Zusammenspiel mit EWM und MES mit. Sie verstehen SAP-Prozesse und können fachliche Anforderungen analysieren

jobs.description: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. The role: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane — the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much. Both are exposed through APIs that give external customers, internal users, and downstream services visibility and control over their limits. This is a high-ownership role. You will define how Capacity and Quota Management matures, from the technical foundations to the tradeoffs that outlast any single feature. Entwickle und steuere die Wachstumsstrategie des Accounts mit Fokus auf Umsatzentwicklung, Profitabilität und nachhaltiges Markenwachstum. Kunden- & Stakeholder-Management Stelle eine proaktive, transparente und verlässliche Kommunikation sicher und übersetze globale Markenstrategien in erfolgreiche lokale Marktaktivitäten. Baue langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und identifiziere neue Wachstums- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Content-, Creator- & Live-Commerce-Steuerung Verantworte die Planung, Koordination und Qualitätskontrolle von Kurzvideo-, Creator- und Livestream-Kampagnen. Analysiere Performance-Daten und leite daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen und Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Erstelle regelmäßige Business Reviews und präsentiere Ergebnisse, Chancen und strategische Empfehlungen gegenüber Kunden und internen Stakeholdern. Your profile Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Growth, Performance Marketing, E-Commerce, Brand Management, Commercial Growth oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion. jobs.title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Your mission About L1VE L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth. Your Role As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models. You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management. In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes. jobs.description: Your mission We’re looking for you! TikTok Shop is changing the way people shop online – and you can be part of it from the very beginning. GENUINE is one of Germany’s leading TikTok Shop partners, and we’re looking for a Shop Manager (m/f/d) to join our team in Cologne. You’ll own the operational performance of some of our most important TikTok Shops – making sure prices are live, campaigns are registered, ads are running, stock is available, and every shop is set up to grow. Your mission: turn commercial strategy into flawless execution. You’ll work closely with our Growth and Creator teams, manage everything happening inside Seller Center, and use performance and profitability data to identify the next growth opportunities. Join one of Europe’s most sought-after TikTok Shop agencies and take ownership of the engine behind high-performing TikTok Shops. Shop Ownership: You take operational ownership of a selection of our core TikTok Shops – ensuring pricing, promotions, campaigns, listings, stock, and overall shop health are always on track. Pricing & Promotions: You implement pricing and promotional strategies in Seller Center and identify the best mechanics – from platform coupons and flash deals to product discounts, bundles, and campaign entries. Campaign Management: You register products and shops for TikTok campaigns, deals, and platform programs, ensuring deadlines and eligibility requirements are met. Performance & Profitability: You analyze performance at product, campaign, and account level – understanding what drives GMV, what actually generates margin, and where the next growth opportunity sits. Ads & Boosting: You set up and optimize TikTok Shop ad campaigns, manage budgets and bidding, and boost high-performing creator content and creator live streams. Stock & Forecasting: You monitor inventory and forecast demand based on promotions, campaigns, and creator activity – identifying potential out-of-stock risks before they impact performance. jobs.title: Group Data Protection Officer
jobs.description: Group Data Protection Officer | M-KOPA Remote (covering Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa and the UK) You're the lawyer people call when a data question has no easy answer. You're accomplished. You're respected. You're probably even happy. But is your work protecting millions of people who are trusting a formal financial service with their personal information for the very first time? That is the question at the heart of this role. The trust you'd be protecting M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers , up from 5 million in 2024, and has unlocked $2+ billion in credit . 86% of our customers report an improved quality of life, 70% use our products to earn an income, and 55% are accessing products and services for the first time. Behind them stand 2,300+ employees and 35,000 agents . Every one of those customers has handed us personal information, and they did it because they believed we would handle it with care. Across Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Uganda and the UK, that belief is held under six different sets of rules, each with its own expectations about consent, retention, cross-border transfers and what happens when something goes wrong. The customers who benefit most from what we build are often the ones with the least room to absorb a mistake with their data, and that is the standard this role exists to hold. Why this timing matters You may have seen us advertising several roles across Legal, Risk and Compliance. That is deliberate, not random. We've moved from 5 million customers to 7 million, and we are now building beyond 10 million. The legal, risk and privacy foundations have to be laid ahead of that growth, not scrambled together after it. New markets, new products and new partners all arrive with new data questions. Joining now means shaping the privacy programme while its biggest chapters are still ahead of it. jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack - EMEA Pricing and Affordability You’ll join EMEA Pricing & Affordability, the team that owns how an order is priced for consumers across EMEA: service and delivery fees, distance-based pricing and surcharges, fee discounts and the benefits that subscribers get. Our work sits right at the cart and checkout, on the new Pedregal platform shared across Deliveroo and Wolt. Price is the most visible part of every order. Getting it right means customers can see what they’ll pay and trust it, and can afford to order again. That drives conversion, order frequency and retention, and it is one of the biggest levers on both consumer growth and marketplace economics. Our roadmap covers subscriber pricing, service fee optimisation, distance-based pricing, long distance surcharges and priority delivery, so the work reaches millions of orders in many markets. As a full stack engineer on this team you’ll take pricing features from idea to production: designing fee and discount logic on the backend, building the checkout and basket experience that shows it, and measuring the result through experiments. You’ll be expected to be comfortable with Go and React, with correctness and testing for money-critical code, and with working closely with Product, Data and the teams across Pedregal. Your changes will be seen by consumers within weeks of shipping, and you’ll help decide what we build next. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack to join our London team. In this role, you’ll help us build and scale seamless, high-performance features that span our entire stack, ensuring a world-class experience for our customers, partners, and riders.

jobs.description: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades. At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Customer Success at Duffel Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel. Once the deal is signed, you'll take that design into implementation as the customer's technical point of contact, making sure they go live smoothly with the best setup for their use case. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success. You'll be our first Solutions Engineer, so the way you do this job will become how the team works as it grows. Chez Eco-Compteur, nous aidons les villes et les gestionnaires d’espaces naturels à décider sur des faits, pas à l’intuition. Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Sujet de stage Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage. Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority. As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise. If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you. jobs.description: sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites. It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn t have to. Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. jobs.description: Omschrijving Wij zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Ketenregisseur voor het Ministerie van Financiën, binnen het directoraat-generaal Herstel Toeslagen (DGH). DGH coördineert het traject van en voor gedupeerden van de toeslagenaffaire en voert regie op zowel het herstelbeleid als de uitvoeringsketen en gemeenten. Binnen DGH richt de Taskforce Versnelling Bezwaren zich op het versnellen van de bezwaarafhandeling. Om deze versnelling effectief uit te voeren, is het belangrijk dat UHT samen met haar ketenpartners dossiers en deelproducten tijdig en in het benodigde volume oplevert. Hiervoor moet de gehele keten optimaal functioneren. Als ketenregisseur bewaak je directieoverstijgend en doorlopend deze keten. Je ziet toe op goed vraag- en aanbodmanagement, werkt samen met professionals aan procesoptimalisatie en adviseert verschillende directies over de aansturing vanuit ketenperspectief. Je legt verantwoording af aan de directeur BBI. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je voert regie op de keten van het opvragen van dossiers tot het doorzetten naar de Bezwaar Advies Commissie (BAC). Je haalt prioriteiten op en stemt deze af met de betrokken partijen. Je bewaakt doorlooptijden en voorraden binnen de keten. Je initieert en leidt het wekelijkse ketenoverleg en zorgt voor een heldere actie- en besluitenlijst. Je signaleert en escaleert knelpunten en zorgt ervoor dat verbeteringen worden geborgd. Je zorgt voor een actueel ketenoverzicht met afspraken en aanspreekpunten, een wekelijkse monitor en een duidelijke escalatieroute. Je zorgt voor een goede overdracht aan de lijn. Wat vragen wij? jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Bei uns erwartet dich ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit Verantwortung auf Augenhöhe - ohne Hierarchien. Für unseren Bereich Forward Deployed Engineering suchen wir dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht empfiehlt, sondern baut, deployt und in Produktion verantwortet. Was dich erwartet Forward Deployed heißt bei uns: Du bist Beobachter, Architekt und Entwickler in einer Person. Dieselbe Person, die das Problem beim Kunden versteht, schreibt den Code, der es löst - und bleibt, bis es produktiv läuft. End-to-End-Ownership: Du verantwortest Deployments von der Discovery über technisches Scoping, Architektur und Build bis zum Produktions-Rollout in der Infrastruktur des Kunden - eingebettet in dessen Engineering- und Fachteams. Full-Stack, wörtlich gemeint: Du arbeitest über alle Schichten - Model-Serving (vLLM, eigene GPU-Cluster), Agent-Gateways und Runtimes, RAG-/GraphRAG-Pipelines, spezialisierte Agenten, Integration in ERP, CRM, DMS und Legacy-Systeme. Auf erprobtem Fundament: Du deployst und erweiterst unsere Produkt-Stacks (mAIstack, VoiceAI, Amicable) beim Kunden, statt jedes Projekt bei null zu beginnen – mit LLMs wie GPT, Gemini, Claude oder Nemotron, Agent-Frameworks und agentischen Harnesses. Vector-Datenbanken und RAG sind dabei Handwerkszeug; als Senior sorgst du dafür, dass die Systeme im Betrieb messbar und beherrschbar bleiben – über Dataset-basierte Evaluations, Logging/Tracing und Observability. Der Rückfluss ist Teil des Jobs: Was sich im Feld als wiederkehrendes Muster erweist, kodifizierst du mit deinem Team in unseren Produkten, Skills und Playbooks. Dein Projektwissen bleibt nicht beim Kunden liegen - es macht das nächste Deployment schneller. Kunde auf Augenhöhe: Du entwickelst in Workshops ein gemeinsames

jobs.title: Senior Software Entwickler Java Fullstack*
jobs.description: Was dich erwartet Full Stack Entwicklung : Du entwickelst und realisierst Java- sowie Webanwendungen im Front- und Backendbereich – deine Kreativität in Kundenprojekten ist gefragt! Je nach Interesse und Background hast du die Möglichkeit technische (Teil-)Projektleitung zu übernehmen. Qualitätshüter : Clean Code, Test Driven Development und DevOps sind für dich keine Fremdwörter, sondern gehören zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug. Durchdachte Architektur: Die ist für dich die Grundlage guter Software. Technologie & Innovation: Du bist immer auf der Suche nach den neuesten Trends, Architekturen und Technologien und hast keine Scheu, sie auszuprobieren. Problemlösung: Du identifizierst technische Probleme, optimierst bestehende Lösungen und findest kreative Ansätze. Kollaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Teams zusammen, um bestmögliche Lösungen im Projekt zu finden. Beraterrolle: Du bist nicht nur der Entwickler, sondern auch der Berater in Kundenprojekten und bringst dein Know-how aktiv ein. Weiterentwicklung: Praxisorientierte Trainings insbesondere in Architektur- und Cloudthemen ebenso wie regelmäßiger Erfahrungsaustausch in unseren Gilden ist Teil unserer DNA. Was du mitbringst Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Fullstack-Entwicklung, im Backend mit Schwerpunkt in Java, gern auch ergänzt durch Kotlin oder Python. Du hast tiefgreifende Kenntnisse im Java Backend mit Fokus auf die Spring Welt, insbesondere Spring Boot und Spring Cloud. Du beherrschst im Frontend mindestens ein modernes Frameworks wie React oder Angular. Du bringst Erfahrung in CI/CD-Pipelines, Containerisierung und Cloud-Diensten mit. Deine hohe Selbstorganisation, dein starker Teamgeist sowie deine Problemlösungskompetenz runden dein Profil ab. Du bringst bestenfalls bereits (Teil-)Projektleitungserfahrung mit. Du sprichst deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und die Kommunikation auf Englisch stellt für kein Problem dar. Worauf du dich freuen kannst - unsere Benefits Spannende Projekte

Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data. About the role Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on. jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain that moves them from donation to resale is offline, manual and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We run a B2B marketplace where resellers and stores buy clothing in bulk, and we build the AI systems that digitise the supply chain behind it. Our buyers sell on eBay, Vinted, Depop, Whatnot, eBay Live and TikTok Shop, or run vintage stores from Brick Lane to Paris to New York. They source graded stock from wholesalers and rag houses across many countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise an item from a single photo. We are now going well beyond vintage. Live sellers can sell almost anything, and there is an opportunity for Fleek to be the backend for B2B resale. We've now started onboarding customers alongside supply from Japan, South Korea, the Philippines and Thailand. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill and tripled in size year on year. We've raised ~$50M from a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital and others, and recently closed our Series B. Our advisors and private investors include operators behind Depop, Shopify and Postmates. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. About the role You'll join the GTM team as our GTM Engineer, reporting to our GTM lead and working day to day with the new business team. You'll own the system we use to find and win customers, on both sides of the marketplace. On the demand side, that means online resellers, live sellers and physical stores in the UK, Europe and the US, buying vintage, deadstock, new with tags and luxury. jobs.title: Meridial – Senior Research Software Engineer – Image Processing
jobs.description: About Meridial Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system. Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency ( ARIA ). The technical challenge Our imaging platform records the activity of neurons and synapses in the living brain. The scientific value of these recordings depends on converting raw images into reliable, quantitative data. This is a demanding image processing problem. Fluorescence signals are faint, noisy and spatially overlapping; residual tissue motion and other imaging artefacts must be corrected; in addition to conventional planar frames, data may be acquired from arbitrarily shaped 3D regions or several depths at once; properties vary between signal types and experimental configurations; and the same cells and synapses must be reliably matched across imaging sessions spanning weeks. You will build a software package that addresses these challenges in two modes: real-time processing and visualisation, with latencies of tens to hundreds of milliseconds, that inform experimental decisions at the microscope, and offline pipelines that deliver maximum accuracy for scientific analysis and serve as the benchmark for the real-time methods. The impact of this work is direct and visible: your software will be used at the microscope as experiments unfold, and your pipelines will generate the data underpinning new insights into how neural circuits function and how they change in disease. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. What started as an encrypted email service has grown into an ecosystem of privacy-first products, including Proton Mail, VPN, Drive, Pass, and Calendar, used by millions of people worldwide. We re profitable, independent, and building for the long term. Free from venture capital control and advertising-driven business models, we focus on what matters most: our users. Our work helps protect digital freedom, from everyday privacy to supporting journalists and activists in challenging environments. Today, we re an international team of 700+ people, with offices across 9 countries. We have high standards for the people we hire and the work we do. You ll work alongside talented, driven colleagues who challenge each other, take ownership, and care about getting things right. Explore our open-source projects . The Role We re building something new at Proton and we re hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton s mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You ll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes. We re looking for someone who has lived inside community products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you ve helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong, and you want to do it in a way that doesn t exploit the people using it, this is the role. jobs.description: About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC) GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle. Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s. While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB). A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs). A conceptual design is currently under development, with the project then progressing into pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED) in 2028, followed by front-end engineering design (FEED) and design for manufacturing phases. Completion of the overall design phase (for GID-170) must be achieved by 2032. About the role GFG is looking for several Tritium Process Engineers to join the TFC department and develop the GID-170 and GIGA TFC facilities.
